item.title: TAT bets on domestic travel boom with Thailand Tourism Festival 2026 | TTG Asia
item.description: As global travel continues to face headwinds, the Tourism Authority of Thailand (TAT) is looking inward to stimulate economic growth. The 44th Thailand Tourism Festival (TTF) 2026, taking place from March 25 to 29 at the Queen Sirikit National Convention Centre, promises an immersive journey across all five Thai regions in the heart of Bangkok.

item.description: Concerts and music festivals make magic in tourism​ ▶ 7mins

item.title: Choice Hotels’ Ascend Collection reaches 500 properties with further openings planned | TTG Asia
item.description: Choice Hotels International’s Ascend Collection has reached 500 properties following recent openings in the US, including The Harrison Hotel in Hollywood, Florida, and The Gould Hotel in Seneca Falls, New York.

item.title: IHG brings InterContinental brand back to Manila after 15 years | TTG Asia
item.description: IHG Hotels & Resorts has signed an agreement to bring the InterContinental brand back to Manila with a new hotel scheduled to open in 2032.

item.title: MITE 2026 to showcase new and expanded tourism zones | TTG Asia
item.description: Macao International Travel (Industry) Expo’s 14th edition, taking place from April 10 to 12, will boast several core zones aligned with travel and tourism growth opportunities.

item.title: BWH Hotels sets sights on Asia-Pacific as engine for global growth | TTG Asia
item.description: BWH Hotels is doubling down on Asia-Pacific, identifying it as the primary engine for its goal to expand its portfolio to 5,000 properties.

item.title: TAT aligns with private sector to support tourism during Middle East crisis | TTG Asia
item.description: The Tourism Authority of Thailand (TAT) convened on March 20 for an urgent summit at the Tourism Crisis Monitoring Center to assess the short-, medium- and long-term impacts of the ongoing unrest in the Middle East.

item.title: Asia’s tourism industry faces operational challenges as fuel shortage hits | TTG Asia
item.description: The escalating US-Israel-Iran war, which has impacted Middle Eastern energy infrastructure and choked oil exports bound for Asia via the Straits of Hormuz, is bruising Asia’s tourism businesses.

item.title: Pessimism rises among South-east Asian travel businesses: ASEANTA survey | TTG Asia
item.description: A recent survey conducted by the ASEAN Tourism Association (ASEANTA) and Pear Anderson has revealed that 48 per cent of South-east Asian travel businesses believe that the prospects for their business in 2Q2026 are worse than they had originally anticipated at the start of the year, due to the US-Israel-Iran war impact.

item.title: Sojern names new president and GM of global destinations | TTG Asia
item.description: AI-powered travel marketing platform, Sojern, has appointed Sylvia Weiler as president and general manager of its global destinations business.
